integrity: The all-parameter proof uses Krebs–Verbitsky Lemmas 2.6–2.7 and a branch-thread classification. A fresh finite replay checks 13,056 parameter triples, 12,240 unequal-cycle split times and 16 balanced partitions. The finite computation corroborates the proof; it is not independent audit or a proof of the infinite statement.
scientific limitations: The result classifies refinability, not amenability or compactness, for the standard dumbbell family.
It does not give the full stabilization-depth formula for unequal-cycle dumbbells.
The finite checker covers p,q<=18 and k<=50; the all-parameter theorem rests on the universal-cover proof.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Complete color-refinement orbit classification for dumbbell graphs
